darwin.errorExcerpt:
handshake failed: MCP error -32000: Connection closed
--- stderr (tail) ---
Usage: cx [options] [command]

Local code search for AI coding agents - an index in plain files under .infino/.
Keyword search seconds after `cx index`; semantic and hybrid search when vectors
finish backfilling; SQL with relevance-ranked aggregation over the whole repo.

Options:
  -V, --version              output the version number
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  index [options] [path]     bring the index up to date (incremental; full build
                             on first run)
  search [options] <query>   find code: exact terms and meaning in one ranked
                             pass
  sql [options] <statement>  read-only SQL over the index, including ranked
                             search table functions
  status [options]           show what the index holds and how fresh it is
  usage [options]            show the local ledger of queries run and what each
                             returned (from .infino/usage.jsonl)
  mcp [options]              serve the MCP tools (search / sql / reindex) over
                             stdio
  help [command]             display help for command

Examples:
  cx index                            index the current repo (keyword search is live in seconds)
  cx search "parse_config"            exact terms and meaning, one ranked pass
  cx search "where is auth handled"   works when you don't know the words
  cx sql "SELECT path, SUM(end_line - start_line + 1) AS lines \
          FROM bm25_search('chunks','content','vector index', 300) \
          GROUP BY path ORDER BY lines DESC LIMIT 10"
  cx mcp                              serve the MCP tools (search/sql/reindex) over stdio
